## 0. The film opens COLD

Frame `b01` is the first image. No title, no channel mark, no logo, no build.
Narration starts in the first breath. The mark belongs to the colophon at the end.
(PLAYBOOK 10.31.)

## 1. What is true of every frame

The world clause is in `WORLD.md` and is **locked** — 7 test images, $0.28.
Two inks on off-white stock, coarse halftone, misregistration without a fixed
direction, no gradients, no text of any kind.

**THIS FILM HAS NO CAST.** No people, no figures, no faces, no hands, in any
frame. The world test showed the character does not survive halftone plus
misregistration. `board.py` refuses to emit prompts if any scene names one.

## 2. The four motifs

| motif | what it is | where it recurs |
|---|---|---|
| **THE DOT** | one measured person, always a plain disc | throughout |
| **THE ARROW** | a cause | planted `b07`, paid off `b72` bent back on itself |
| **THE ROOMS** | two rooms in cross-section | **the turn**, `b59` `b60` `b61` |
| **THE RULER** | the instrument | `b45`, turned on itself `b75` |

An object that recurs must be the SAME object, not a description rewritten each
time — that is what produced books-for-sheaf on the last film (PLAYBOOK 10.38).

## 3. Camera quota — enforced in `board.py`, not aspired to

| camera | count | floor |
|---|---:|---:|
| XCU | 9 | 6 |
| CU | 9 | 6 |
| MED | 19 | — |
| WIDE | 19 | — |
| XWIDE | 9 | 8 |
| OVER | 7 | 6 |
| LOW | 6 | 6 |

No more than **three consecutive frames** share a camera distance. The previous
film shipped six near-identical desk shots in a row and it was invisible until
all four contact sheets were laid out together.

## 4. Motion

**STILLS ONLY.** No clips on this film, by decision. Each frame gets the
deterministic push in `assemble.mjs`; nothing is bought.

## 6. Handoff

`production/prompts.json` is generated by `board.py` and carries the locked world
clause appended to every scene. Generate with:

```
node tools/video/generate-frames.mjs videos/who-you-measured --only b01 --publish
```

**One frame first.** It is the rule that would have saved $12.44 on the last film,
and it also settles the open question in `WORLD.md`: whether the edit endpoint
returns above 1920 when conditioned on a world plate alone. Never upscale into
the canvas.
